"Be Alright" is a song by Australian singer and songwriter Dean Lewis.
The song was released in June 2018 as the lead single from Lewis' debut studio album, A Place We Knew.
It reached number one and is certified 10× Platinum in Australia and multi platinum worldwide, including 5× Platinum in the United States.
The discography of Dean Lewis, an Australian singer, consists of three studio albums, one EP and thirty singles.
